<module id="traffic_light">
    <description>A traffic light system with red, yellow, and green indicators, and a pedestrian crossing button.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="pass_request">Request signal for pedestrians to cross.</input>
        <output id="clock" width_description="[7:0]">Internal counter value.</output>
        <output id="red">Red signal indicating the state of the traffic light.</output>
        <output id="yellow">Yellow signal indicating the state of the traffic light.</output>
        <output id="green">Green signal indicating the state of the traffic light.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="idle">Initial state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="s1_red">State after passing the pedestrian request.</parameter>
        <parameter id="s2_yellow">State for yellow signal.</parameter>
        <parameter id="s3_green">State for green signal.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[7:0]">Internal counter for timing control.</reg>
        <reg id="state" width_description="[1:0]">Current state of the traffic light controller.</reg>
        <reg id="p_red">Next value for red signal.</reg>
        <reg id="p_yellow">Next value for yellow signal.</reg>
        <reg id="p_green">Next value for green signal.</reg>
        
        // State transition logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                state <= 2'd0;
            end else begin
                case(state)
                    idle: state <= s1_red;
                    s1_red: begin
                        if(cnt == 3) state <= s3_green;
                        else state <= s1_red;
                    end
                    s2_yellow: begin
                        if(cnt == 3) state <= s1_red;
                        else state <= s2_yellow;
                    end
                    s3_green: begin
                        if(cnt == 3) state <= s2_yellow;
                        else state <= s3_green;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
        
        // Counting logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(!rst_n) begin
                cnt <= 8'd10;
            end else begin
                if(pass_request && green) cnt <= 8'd10;
                else if(!green && p_green) cnt <= 8'd60;
                else if(!yellow && p_yellow) cnt <= 8'd5;
                else if(!red && p_red) cnt <= 8'd10;
                else cnt <= cnt - 1;
            end
        end
        
        // Output assignment
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(!rst_n) begin
                {red,yellow,green} <= 3'b000;
            end else begin
                {red,yellow,green} <= {p_red,p_yellow,p_green};
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Design your implementation here.</implementation>
</module>
